comment: The rotating monthly micro-ranking. Rotate the category on the 1st of each month: update month/title/note, swap in 5-6 real candidate spots (verified via local sources — never invented), reset status to 'measuring', set baseline_date to today, and prune stale cat: keys from buzz-history.json. compute-buzz.mjs scores candidates weekly with the same engine as the Power Rankings (history keys prefixed 'cat:'). LOCKED 12-MONTH CALENDAR (themes fixed, candidate spots researched fresh each rotation): Jul=raspas, Aug=breakfast tacos, Sep=barbacoa, Oct=pan dulce, Nov=menudo, Dec=tamales (publish before Christmas ordering), Jan=caldos, Feb=mariscos (Lent), Mar=fajitas, Apr=elotes & street corn, May=paletas & aguas frescas, Jun=homegrown burgers (no chains). High school football is a separate section, not a category.
title: October: Best Pan Dulce 🥐
note: Breakfast tacos start the day, but no Valley morning is complete without a concha and café — six panaderías baking the Valley's favorite sweet bread fresh every day.
note_es: Los tacos de desayuno arrancan el día, pero ninguna mañana en el Valle está completa sin una concha y café — seis panaderías del Valle horneando el pan dulce favorito, fresco todos los días.
measuring_note: Tracking just started — the first ranking drops Monday. The contenders:
measuring_note_es: Apenas empezamos a medir — el primer ranking sale el lunes. Los contendientes:

spots.known_for_es: Décadas de conchas, donas y tacos de desayuno frescos del mismo horno de Edinburg
